SELECT id, display_name FROM
expense_category unit funding_channel purchase_channel location_label unsupported_dictionary_type
WHERE id = #{p.id} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND parent_id IS NULL FOR SHARE

SELECT p.id, p.display_name, pc.id AS primary_id, pc.display_name AS primary_name, sc.id AS secondary_id, sc.display_name AS secondary_name, u.id AS unit_id, u.display_name AS unit_name, p.last_unit_price, f.id AS funding_id, f.display_name AS funding_name, ch.id AS purchase_id, ch.display_name AS purchase_name FROM product p LEFT JOIN expense_category pc ON pc.id = p.default_primary_category_id AND pc.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN expense_category sc ON sc.id = p.default_secondary_category_id AND sc.parent_id = pc.id AND sc.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN unit u ON u.id = p.default_unit_id AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN funding_channel f ON f.id = p.last_funding_channel_id AND f.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN purchase_channel ch ON ch.id = p.last_purchase_channel_id AND ch.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE p.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (#{p.query} = '' OR p.normalized_name LIKE ('%' || #{p.query} || '%') ESCAPE '\') ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC, p.display_name, p.id LIMIT #{p.limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET default_primary_category_id = #{p.primaryCategoryId}, default_secondary_category_id = #{p.secondaryCategoryId}, default_unit_id = #{p.unitId}, last_unit_price = #{p.unitPrice}, last_quantity = #{p.quantity}, last_funding_channel_id = #{p.fundingChannelId}, last_purchase_channel_id = #{p.purchaseChannelId}, updated_at = #{p.now} WHERE id = #{p.productId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

UPDATE product p SET default_primary_category_id = latest.primary_category_id, default_secondary_category_id = latest.secondary_category_id, default_unit_id = latest.unit_id, last_unit_price = latest.unit_price, last_quantity = latest.quantity, last_funding_channel_id = latest.funding_channel_id, last_purchase_channel_id = latest.purchase_channel_id, updated_at = #{p.now} FROM (SELECT #{p.productId}::uuid AS product_id) target LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT primary_category_id, secondary_category_id, unit_id, unit_price, quantity, funding_channel_id, purchase_channel_id FROM ledger_entry WHERE product_id = target.product_id AND entry_type = 'EXPENSE' AND lifecycle_status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest ON TRUE WHERE p.id = target.product_id AND p.status = 'ACTIVE'
